raw_text: The latest round of fighting between the Myanmar military and the Arakan Army in northern Rakhine has created a fresh humanitarian crisis at the Bangladesh-Myanmar border. The Bangladesh Border Guard resorted to firing warning shots as hundreds of Rohingya attempted to cross into Cox's Bazar district near Teknaf. India's security establishment is closely watching the situation, with BSF and intelligence agencies monitoring potential secondary migration flows through the Chittagong Hill Tracts into Tripura and Mizoram.
clean_text: Myanmar-Arakan Army fighting creates humanitarian crisis at Bangladesh border. BGB fires warning shots. India monitoring secondary Rohingya migration into Tripura and Mizoram.
